result.title: ConvPE: Convolutional Position Embedding Improves Transformers
result.summary: ConvPE (Convolutional Position Embedding) improves both the performance and efficiency of Transformer models in language modeling, long-context extension, and vision. It injects a windowed, content-dependent bias into attention scores through a lightweight causal convolution over a low-dimensional projection of the hidden states. As a lightweight plug-in, ConvPE is compatible with RoPE, attention masks, and KV concatenation. It also supports high-dimensional position embeddings via high-dimensional convolutions. In a reproduction, ConvPE outperforms five 1D baselines and eight 2D baselines. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/wzhagi/convpe.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ConvPE：对隐状态的低维投影施加轻量因果卷积，生成窗口化、内容相关的位置偏置并注入注意力分数，作为插件兼容 RoPE、注意力掩码与 KV 拼接，并在语言建模、长上下文扩展和视觉任务上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其内容相关、局部窗口式的注意力偏置可能可供核查 LVR 中位置、缓存与注意力结构如何影响 latent 状态相似度及长上下文证据使用，但原文不涉及推理状态生成或多步推理，只是方法线索。
